Shipping

All Orders are fulfilled and then shipped to anywhere in the United States in 1-3 working days on average.

Worldwide shipping (other than US) takes 4-8 working days depending on location:

  • Europe: 4-8 days
  • Australia: 4-8 days
  • United Kingdom: 4-8 days
  • Canada: 4-8 days
  • Rest of world: 4-8 days

All orders come with tracking information once shipped.

Returns

Not happy with your purchase? No worries, we've got you covered!

You may return it within 30 days of delivery for a full refund or exchange, no questions asked. To initiate a return, just contact our customer service team at support@thefleeceblanket.com.
